import { Attribution } from 'ox/erc8021';
wallet.sendTransaction({ data: '0x', dataSuffix: Attribution.toDataSuffix({ codes: ['bc_abc123'] }) });

import { builderCodeDataSuffix } from '@base-attribution-os/viem';
wallet.sendTransaction({ data: '0x', dataSuffix: builderCodeDataSuffix('bc_abc123') });

import { Attribution } from 'ox/erc8021';
wallet.sendTransaction({ dataSuffix: Attribution.toDataSuffix({ codes: ['bc_other'] }) });

const Attribution = { toDataSuffix: () => '0x' };
wallet.sendTransaction({ dataSuffix: Attribution.toDataSuffix({ codes: ['bc_abc123'] }) });

import { Attribution } from 'ox/erc8021';
wallet.sendTransaction({ dataSuffix: Attribution.toDataSuffix({ codes: [process.env.BUILDER_CODE] }) });
